title: Session restore / write protection is active
remediation: Install and enable a write filter or disk-restore agent (Windows Unified Write Filter, Deep Freeze, or your café management suite) so each tenant gets a clean machine. Without this, nothing else on a leased PC can be trusted between users — every other control can be undone by the previous tenant.

title: No leftover credential or AI agent key files in the home directory
remediation: Remove SSH keys, cloud credentials, and AI agent/MCP config files from the shared profile, and wipe the profile between sessions. On a leased seat these are a free identity for the next tenant — an AI API key left behind bills someone else.
reference: docs/VISION.md — the AI you invited in is the exposure

title: Screen recall / AI data analysis capture is disabled
remediation: Set DisableAIDataAnalysis to 1 under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI. Periodic screenshots of everything on screen are catastrophic on a shared PC: the next tenant can page back through the previous one's banking or login session.

title: Game DVR background recording is disabled
remediation: Set AllowGameDVR to 0 under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\GameDVR. On a shared gaming PC, background capture can leave the previous tenant's screen recording available to the next tenant.

title: No Recall snapshot store left on disk
remediation: Disabling Recall by policy does not delete what it already captured. Wipe %LOCALAPPDATA%\CoreAIPlatform.00\UKP as part of the between-tenant reset and confirm the restore/write-filter agent covers the user profile. Until it is gone, that folder is the previous tenant's screen, page by page.
reference: Recall snapshot store location (%LOCALAPPDATA%\CoreAIPlatform.00\UKP); docs/VISION.md — AI surface area

title: Clipboard history is disabled
remediation: Set AllowClipboardHistory to 0 under HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System. Clipboard history carries one tenant's copied password straight into the next tenant's session.
reference: CIS / Microsoft — Allow Clipboard History policy

title: Cross-device clipboard sync is disabled
remediation: Set AllowCrossDeviceClipboard to 0. On a leased machine this pushes whatever a stranger copied off the device and into an account you do not control.
reference: Microsoft — Allow Cross Device Clipboard policy

title: An explicit policy exists for the built-in AI assistant
remediation: Set TurnOffWindowsCopilot deliberately (either value) under the WindowsCopilot policy key. The finding here is the absence of a decision: an assistant with system reach on a machine shared by strangers should be allowed or denied on purpose, not inherited from the OS default.

fix.name: TurnOffWindowsCopilot
fix.note: Either value satisfies the rule — the finding is the absence of a decision. This script writes 1 (assistant off), the conservative choice for a seat used by strangers; write 0 instead if your venue deliberately offers it.

title: No leftover AI agent tool or MCP server configs in the home directory
remediation: Remove agent tool and MCP server configuration files (claude_desktop_config.json, .cursor/mcp.json, .codex/config.toml, ...) from the shared profile and wipe the profile between sessions. These files map exactly which tools and servers the previous tenant's agent could reach — often with tokens embedded in env blocks — and hand the next tenant a preconfigured, pre-approved agent.

title: Local AI model servers are not exposed to the network
remediation: Bind local model servers to loopback only: OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1 for Ollama, turn off 'Serve on local network' in LM Studio, --host 127.0.0.1 for Gradio/KoboldCpp/Jan — or block the port in the host firewall. Bound to every interface on a shared LAN, an unauthenticated model server is free compute for anyone on the network and lets a neighbour read prompts, pull or delete models, and reuse the previous tenant's setup.
reference: Ollama FAQ — OLLAMA_HOST binding; docs/VISION.md — AI surface area

title: Browser password saving is disabled by policy
remediation: Set PasswordManagerEnabled to 0 in the Chrome and Edge policy keys. A saved password on a leased seat is handed to whoever sits down next.

title: Automatic logon is disabled
remediation: Set HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\AutoAdminLogon to 0. Auto-logon hands every walk-up user an authenticated desktop.
reference: CIS Microsoft Windows Benchmark — Interactive logon

title: No cleartext logon password stored in the registry
remediation: Delete the DefaultPassword value under Winlogon. When auto-logon is configured this stores the account password in cleartext, readable by any local user.
reference: MS KB324737 — Turn on automatic logon

fix.name: DefaultPassword
fix.note: Removes the cleartext password value only; no account is changed.

title: Built-in Guest account is disabled
remediation: Run: net user guest /active:no. The Guest account is a well-known anonymous access path.

title: Inbound Remote Desktop is disabled
remediation: A public terminal should not accept inbound RDP. Set fDenyTSConnections to 1 unless remote management is genuinely required (then restrict by firewall).

title: Autorun/AutoPlay is disabled on all drive types
remediation: Set NoDriveTypeAutoRun to 0xFF (255). USB autorun is a classic infection vector in shared-PC venues.

title: Windows Firewall is enabled for all profiles
remediation: Run: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state on.
reference: CIS — Windows Firewall with Advanced Security

fix.run: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state on

title: Microsoft Defender real-time protection is on
remediation: Re-enable real-time protection, or confirm a supported third-party AV is active. Shared PCs see constant untrusted files and downloads.

fix.note: Skip this if a supported third-party AV owns real-time protection on these seats.

title: Screen auto-lock is enabled (idle timeout set)
remediation: Set a screen-saver idle timeout so abandoned sessions lock. A value of 0 means the session never locks on its own.
reference: CIS — Interactive logon: Machine inactivity limit

title: Screen auto-lock timeout is 15 minutes or less
remediation: Reduce the idle timeout to 900 seconds or less so abandoned sessions lock promptly.
reference: CIS — Interactive logon: Machine inactivity limit

title: Password is required when the screen resumes
remediation: Enable 'On resume, display logon screen' so the lock actually requires re-authentication.
